answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation with a decayed trust terrace: each identity must lock a bond that rises with every new account it spawns, so a sybil farmer pays exponentially more per extra persona. Honest work refracts through a prism of peer attestations - payments, uptime, and task quality - so one actor many clones all share a single reputation signal and cannot multiply their influence. Clones add cost without adding trust.
